prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the services you need. I can help you find the best fit, but first a few quick questions:

- What are your main goals? (brand strategy, web design, SEO, paid ads, social, PR, B2B lead gen, etc.)
- What’s your approximate budget (monthly or project)?
- Company type/size and industry (startup, SMB, enterprise; retail, healthcare, tech, nonprofit…)
- Do you need a local agency for face-to-face work, or is remote OK?

How I’ll choose an agency for you
- Match services and industry experience to your goals
- Look for measurable results and case studies (KPIs)
- Verify client roster and retention
- Check reviews (Clutch, Google, LinkedIn) and awards
- Confirm team size, processes, and communication style

Quick pointers to get started
- Enterprise/large-brand work: consider full-service agencies with integrated teams and proven enterprise case studies.
- Growth/paid-media/SEO: look for agencies with transparent reporting, audited ad performance, and CRO experience.
- Branding/design: prioritize creative portfolios and storytelling work, not just traffic metrics.
- B2B lead gen: a mix of content strategy, LinkedIn, account-based marketing, and marketing automation expertise matters.

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short, ranked shortlist of highly rated Kansas City agencies by specialty (I’ll pull recent reviews and case studies), or
- Recommend 3–5 agencies matched to your answers above.

Which option would you like?
